nrpe_server_address.description: IP address the NRPE daemon should bind to (use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

nrpe_server_port.description: TCP port for NRPE daemon to listen on.

nrpe_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections (strongly recommended in production).

nrpe_ssl_cipher_list.description: OpenSSL cipher list to allow (used only if SSL is enabled).

nrpe_ssl_port.description: Port for SSL/TLS connections (used only if SSL is disabled on main port — rare).

nrpe_connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a new connection before closing it.

nrpe_request_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a request from the client.

nrpe_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to the log file (disable in production).

nrpe_log_file.description: Path to the NRPE log file.

nrpe_pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the NRPE daemon.

items.description: Allowed IP addresses (or CIDR ranges) that may connect to this NRPE instance.

nrpe_allowed_hosts.description: List of trusted hosts allowed to query NRPE commands.

name.description: Name of the command (used by Nagios/Icinga to call via check_nrpe).

executable.description: Path to the Nagios plugin or script to execute.

arguments.description: Optional arguments to pass to the executable.

nrpe_commands.description: List of commands that may be invoked remotely by the monitoring server.

nrpe_include_dir.description: Directory to scan for additional config files (e.g., /etc/nagios/nrpe.d/). Leave empty to disable.

nrpe_escape_command_arguments.description: Escape special characters in command arguments to prevent shell injection (recommended).

nrpe_log_level.description: Verbosity level of logging: 0=minimal, 5=debug (see docs for details).

nrpe_bind_address.description: Optional specific IP address to bind (overrides server_address if set).

nrpe_ipv4_only.description: Restrict NRPE to IPv4 connections only.

nrpe_ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if SSL is enabled).

nrpe_ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if SSL is enabled).

nrpe_ssl_ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate for peer verification (optional, improves security).
